coreClaim: Conversation and Roleplay provider streams keep journal compaction off the foreground persistence path, including journals that have crossed normal byte or entry thresholds.

outOfScope: Concurrent mutation during an already-running compaction

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Once a message write begins a turn and while its LLM stream is registered, normal deferred compaction cannot acquire the global storage write permit; acknowledged mutations remain journal-backed and shutdown still materializes them.
claimBoundary.riskType: persistent storage and foreground generation concurrency
entrypoints: AppState LLM stream registration and unregistration
legacyPathsOrFormats: Existing data directories require no migration
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not interrupt a compaction that started before foreground activity.
Normal age, entry, and byte thresholds resume after foreground activity and its 30-second persistence grace.
Shutdown and explicit atomic boundaries still force durable materialization.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: A large prompt-snapshot mutation crossed the 256 KiB journal threshold immediately, or a long provider response outlived the 60-second journal age, so deferred compaction still held the global write permit when the reply and memory-capture writes arrived.
contractLaneGate.producer: src-tauri AppState LLM stream lifecycle and storage deferred compaction scheduler
contractLaneGate.consumer: Conversation and Roleplay reply, swipe, character-state, and memory-capture persistence
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Primary-file compaction is background maintenance and must not outrank an active model response or the writes that immediately persist its result.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Message writes arm a 30-second registration grace, registered LLM streams increment a shared foreground activity count, deferred flush checks that state before and after acquiring the write permit, and stream teardown adds a 30-second reply-persistence grace.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: AppState owns provider stream registration and FileStorage owns journal durability, deferred scheduling, and write serialization.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not hide the pause in UI pending state, skip durable writes, or discard journal size safeguards.
regressionProof: The foreground size-threshold test failed before implementation because FileStorage had no foreground activity contract.
A production-policy message test proves the pre-registration grace covers a 300 KiB mutation.
An AppState integration test proves a registered LLM stream defers unrelated threshold compaction.
Existing LLM cancellation and failure tests prove the drop guard unregisters every completed or failed stream.

positiveRows.claim: A journal above its configured byte threshold remains journal-backed while foreground activity is registered.
A production message write cannot start threshold compaction in the gap before the provider stream registers.
positiveRows.evidence: message_write_arms_grace_before_foreground_stream_registration preserves the primary and pending journal after a 300 KiB patch.

positiveRows.claim: A registered provider stream defers compaction from an unrelated collection that could otherwise block message persistence through the global write gate.
positiveRows.evidence: registered_llm_stream_defers_unrelated_threshold_compaction preserves the character primary past the deferred-flush debounce.

contradictionRows.claim: Foreground deferral must not weaken shutdown durability.
contradictionRows.evidence: Both new storage tests force shutdown materialization and observe the journal removed with the mutation readable.

contradictionRows.claim: Failed, cancelled, or abandoned provider streams must not leave compaction paused.
contradictionRows.evidence: LlmStreamRegistration unregisters on Drop and all eight llm_stream cleanup tests pass.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: No stored row, collection, journal, or cancellation payload changes shape.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The change adds only in-memory scheduling state and lifecycle calls.

ownedFacts.description: On merge 93bb4d8313, Conversation samples had provider times from 5.9 seconds to at least 48 seconds while message writes still waited between roughly 5 and 43 seconds behind compaction.
ownedFacts.evidence: Live Pi performance diagnostics separated llm_stream spans from storage.operation spans.

ownedFacts.description: Journal age alone cannot protect a turn because large prompt snapshots cross the byte threshold and provider responses can outlive the age threshold.
ownedFacts.evidence: JournalCompactionPolicy checks byte, age, and entry thresholds independently.

ownedFacts.description: The pending journal remains the acknowledged durability boundary while foreground compaction is deferred.
ownedFacts.evidence: Focused tests preserve the primary, retain the journal, and force successful shutdown materialization.

userActionCopy.description: No migration or cleanup is required. Optional rollback protection is a stopped-app copy of the existing collection primaries and pending journals.

userActionCopy.destination: A user-controlled backup folder outside the De-Koi application data directory
